text: Compared with the earlier promise, the difference is smaller than it seems. Isaac is the child of the covenant, the one through whom the nations are to be blessed; and God turns that promise into a test. Much depends upon one word, _hineni_, "here I am," which Abraham speaks three times, to God, to Isaac, and to the angel, and which means something different on each occasion. Its cost rises. A word of presence becomes, in Abraham's mouth, a word of loss, and it costs him most when he says it to the angel.
